Praise be to Jesus Christ. My name is Sajikumar. I come from near Pariyaram Medical College in Kannur district. This is my my younger son, Abhinand.
This is my wife, Soumya P.V. I took the Covenant here on 07/02/2024. I took the Covenant.
The situation that led me to take the Covenant was that my son had a disease called genetic chorea.
That illness itself is the reason I came here and entered into this Covenant.
The reason for coming to the Covenant was that, after seeing this illness, a woman named Sarojini,
who works at the Payyannur BRC and is associated with teachers from Mathamangalam School, sent me a newsletter.
In the same way, she also sent me prayers through WhatsApp. It was after seeing all this that I came to Kreupasanam.
Another reason for coming was that I had been undergoing a lot of treatments. This condition called genetic chorea is a disease that keeps worsening.
When I came, his legs were trembling like this—constantly shaking. When I was coming, my wife was rubbing his legs like this.
At that time, I knew that this was a disease that would lead him to a bedridden state.
The doctors at Pariyaram told me that. The doctors at MIMS Hospital, Kannur, also said the same.
Likewise, the doctors at Amrita Hospital also told us the same. Then they said an operation would be needed, but since even that had no guaranteed success, it could not be done.
Initially, he was a child who could write, and run, jump, and play like normal children.
Gradually, as the condition worsened, he reached a stage where we had to feed him by hand.
He reached a condition where he could not walk, where his legs would not support him.
Even after treatment, when he reached a state where he could not move his legs at all,
it was at that point—like catching onto a lifeline—that I came to know about Kreupasanam, and by the grace of this Mother, I was able to come here.
That coming itself became the reason my entire life was completely transformed. Before coming, I had consumed alcohol as usual, and I kept the remaining alcohol at home,
thinking I would drink it after returning. I thought I would bring my wife and make her take the Covenant. I was living casually like that.
I was a person who used to gamble by betting money. I would go for work, but along with that, I would also drink alcohol frequently.
I came here to take the Covenant. When I came here and took the Covenant, I was given the grace to take the Holy Mother during the procession. Taking the Mother,
and coming from there to this altar—I still do not even remember that moment. I came to a state where it felt like all my sins had been washed away.
After coming here and returning home, I did not just throw away the alcohol, but from that moment until today, I have completely abandoned gambling.
That habit has left my memory itself. The Mother lifted me up to that extent.
The reason I am saying this next is that when his illness worsened and we came again for the second time for renewal,
Father placed his hand on my son’s head and blessed him.
After that blessing, the trembling in his legs completely stopped. The Holy Mother blessed me and blessed our family.
Likewise, the condition where we had to feed him by hand also stopped. In the same way, when my wife was taking psychiatric tablets,
when we came, all of us came together to this altar.
Sitting here, crying and praying, she prayed, “My Mother, I am taking six or seven tablets a day. Mother, please free me from these tablets.”
She prayed like that while sitting here.
I took the Covenant and returned. After returning, we continued this prayer at home.
The next day after we came here, she took all those tablets and kept them aside. I did not even realize that she had stopped taking the tablets.
That is, when I checked after one or two months, all those tablets were still lying there.
I used to give her the medicine regularly every month. She herself used to take them.
All those tablets were still there. I became very afraid.
But she had no difficulties at all. Everything was normal. There were no issues, nothing abnormal.
This illness had come after shock treatment given during a prior condition. After one course, when it reduced,
the doctor had said that she would need to continue taking those tablets. By the blessing of the Mother,
from that day onward she stopped taking those tablets, and until today she has not had to take them.
The doctor said, “Let it remain stopped. There is no need to take them anymore.” In this way,
the Holy Mother and Jesus Christ blessed me and blessed my family with the greatest blessing.
Likewise, even though my son had difficulties in his legs, last year he participated in sports under the differently-abled category and went to Kochi.
He became the Kannur district champion in standing javelin throw,
and my son was able to reach fourth place at the district level. That was a year of great recognition for him—last year was a great blessing.
Because getting a chance to go to Kochi—that is, to the state level—is not a small thing. Many people came and congratulated him. He received around 23 medals.
In the same way, this past year, and the year before that as well,
he got an opportunity to play football to qualify for the state level. He played in many areas and competitions representing Kannur district.
When he went to play for Kannur district, his performance was very poor at first. I recited the Creed and placed blessed medal into his pocket.
From there, he scored three goals. He was selected as the Kannur district champion, and he got the opportunity to play at the state level.
Thus, this year he also participated exclusively in the event at Thiruvananthapuram, and these achievements were published in all the newspapers.
The news that came about my son was such that not only this state, but the whole world now can know about him.
This report was published in all the newspapers that covered it—Manorama, Mathrubhumi, and all major papers.
This was news published on the 22nd date, and it appeared on the front page itself. In this way, through the power of the Holy Spirit that was poured upon him,
he came forward using heavenly blessings. He loves the Holy Spirit deeply, and through that strength, he was able to play well and perform with discipline.
Likewise, through the power of the Holy Spirit, he was lifted up and honored by everyone. We were able to experience great joy because of this.
In the same way, I should also say this: at my house there was a coconut tree that had almost completely withered. It was a six-year-old tree.
Its crown had rotted, and it had been pulled out and damaged. I had even kept a machete ready to cut it down.
After keeping it there, I prayed the Creed and applied blessed salt at the base of the tree.
After one or two weeks, there was still no visible change, and I thought it was dead. Then for about a month, I was not able to go there.
When I went and checked after two or three days of returning, I saw that the crown had sprouted again and was growing well.
In this way, by using these blessed objects, we have received many blessings—not small ones. I have received many blessings, and in our family,
there is lasting happiness and peace. I should also mention that my elder son received a job.
That was exactly according to a word Father spoke at the altar—it was precisely about my son.
That also came to pass. Father had said that a person whose name starts with the letter “S” would give testimony.
My name is Sajikumar. On the very date Father mentioned, that blessing was received exactly. I heard Father say it here during prayer.
That blessing was received very precisely. Likewise, I regularly listen to Father’s daily prayers, I would share them to 10-13 groups,
All the newspapers I receive, I take them to government hospitals, praying that they may reach those who are deserving.
I personally go and distribute them there. Every day, until all the newspapers are given out, I remain there—not handing them out hastily,
I distribute the newspapers after sharing my life experiences and the blessings I have received. In that way, about six people have come here along with me till today.
Likewise, a woman from near my house has also come. The reason she came is that her sister’s younger child had jaundice and dengue fever,
along with several other illnesses, and they were admitted in the hospital. I took this blessed salt, gave it to them, prayed, and told them to use it.
The doctor was surprised. The doctor asked how this had changed. The jaundice completely disappeared, and there were no complications at all.
With that faith, they took the Covenant today.
In this way, I have received many blessings. I thank the Holy Spirit, Jesus, and the Mother of Kreupasanam a thousand times for giving me the grace to give testimony at this holy altar.
As for works of mercy, I help those who cannot be clothed by providing clothes. When I see the poor, I help them with money as well during festivals.
I buy kits, and along with my family, I go and distribute them, saying that they are given through the Mother of Kreupasanam.
Likewise, when people come to hospitals due to illness, I take them in my own vehicle.
I do not take even a single rupee. It is my own vehicle. I go with them, stay with them, and help them in every way.
Once, there was a person I stayed with. When I went to accompany that person, it was necessary for me to stay with them because due to their family situation, I did not have even 10 rupees with me that time.
At lunchtime, while I was there and becoming tired, I began to see something like the numbers two-two-two-five appearing faintly before my eyes in red ink.
It felt as though the Mother was showing something. That evening, when I took my vehicle and was returning home, I thought of withdrawing some money from the ATM.
When I stopped the vehicle and went to withdraw, I saw lottery tickets showing the numbers two-two-two-five. I took them.
I felt that the Mother had shown this to me. I took them—there were nine tickets.
I took the tickets and kept them safely. When I checked the next day, what the Mother had given me was ₹45,000
At a time when I had not even a single rupee and was deeply distressed,
and it was the rainy season, I did not even have ten rupees. When I took people in my vehicle, if fuel was finished, that alone was a problem. I had nothing.
Still, I bought food for them with the little money I had and gave it myself. In that way, the Mother has given me many blessings—not small ones.
Like pouring water out in the open, I have received blessings abundantly.
Like pouring water out in the open, I have received blessings abundantly.
There was no other option but to go and sell that land. Because of illnesses and other matters, we were facing severe financial difficulties.
I took the blessed salt and sprinkled it in that plot of land. Even though the agreement period was not yet over—there were still ten days remaining— the land was sold,
Likewise, when needy people come running to my house, I give them donations without hesitation.
I also offer two days of voluntary service for house construction when needed. For any kind of service, for the needs of the locality,
I go and help as much as I am able to. For blessing me in this way, I offer a thousand crore thanks to the Mother of Kreupasanam and to Jesus.
Galatians 5:24–25 says: “Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
If we live by the Spirit, let us also walk by the Spirit.” Dear brothers and sisters, this brother Sajikumar, who took the Kreupasanam Marian Covenant,
is joyfully and gratefully giving testimony to the special divine experiences received by each member of his family.
When we take the Covenant, we are making a decision in the presence of God to receive deliverance from the desires of the flesh.
When we light the lamp and make the first vow of the Covenant, we decide to renounce sinful habits and life patterns that strengthen fleshly desires.
From this day until ninety days, whatever the Covenant expects from us,
That decision itself is a promise to live in the love of God, and it becomes the reason for divine interventions.
That is why there is no need to struggle for one month or one year.
From the very moment of returning after taking the Covenant, two major weaknesses that had been attached to this brother’s life were removed, as he has testified.
Along with that, there were serious health struggles affecting his spouse within the family, which until then were seen only with tears.
The brother says that it was enough for him to buy and keep the medicines—she herself would take them. But after taking the Covenant,
only after two months did he realize that from the day the Covenant was taken, she had not taken the medicine even for a single day.
Normally, there should have been changes in her behavior, severe restlessness, and difficulties—but there were no problems at all.
He saw her living calmly and peacefully. When he took her to the doctor, the doctor himself confirmed that since there were no issues,
there was no need to take any medicine anymore.
In the Covenant, we should not walk as though placing one foot in each of two boats.
If we entrust an intention into God’s hands, seeking to receive it by God’s power, we must have the humility and sincerity to surrender ourselves completely to God.
That is why, from the day this sister took the Covenant, under the protection of our Holy Mother, by the power of Jesus, and by the grace of His Precious Blood,
she fully believed and became inwardly convinced that Jesus has the power to remove all the exhaustion and instability that her life had been passing through.
Entrusting those physical and mental struggles into the hands of the Mother, she received complete healing and now stands healthy at this altar. Thirdly, the brother testified about his son—a child with many limitations.
Yet the Holy Mother held his hand and led him forward, granting him good success in Special School Olympics, giving him excellent achievements at the state level,
so that everyone praises him. In this way, the family itself is lifted up further, as the son overcomes even his limitations.
The family testifies that God protected him and granted him victories under the safeguarding hand of God’s right hand. Dear brothers and sisters, the Covenant life is a divine call
to fully surrender our way of life into God’s hands. If we are ready to surrender completely, we will never feel that we cannot change or be saved.
Even in areas where we think nothing will work out, God intervenes within a short time, by the grace of the Mother’s apparition,
and through the grace of intercessory prayer offered every moment for the children who have taken the Covenant—millions of children—
and through the spiritual fruits Father Joseph has received during his 39 years of priestly life,
by the power of the constant intercessory prayers he offers to the Holy Mother and to the Son for the children who come and pray at this shrine.
That is why this family received healing from illnesses, freedom from debts,
and protection over their son’s life in such a way that the world itself recognizes him, even amid his limitations.
Standing at this Mother’s altar, no matter how broken we are,
if we sincerely believe in the Mother’s apparition and entrust our lives into her hands,
we will be able to experience the presence and protection of the Mother, who will do great things for us.
Let us clap our hands and offer this testimony, thanking the Holy Mother for all the goodness received by this family.
